Game Overview

At its heart, Chitu Adventures is a adventure game about embark on a thrilling 2D platforming quest as Chitu, collecting scattered project papers in a perilous office environment. With cunning obstacles and scheming coworkers, master the art of double jumping and strategic timing through eight increasingly challenging levels. Unravel an office drama while ensuring every paper counts!
